best_idea: An area hit that halves its damage per quarter-tile of distance, with a hard one-tile cut-off, gives a shockwave or finisher a falloff that needs only integer shifts and no square root.
decision_why: Frankendom's many-on-one fights can use a distance falloff for a shockwave, but the donor's splash hits every unit in radius with no accuracy roll and no team check on the damage, so each hit must go through the server-verified path with guard and a cap of three targets.
acceptance: In a 3-on-1 fight, a shockwave centred on the attacker's tile deals a quarter of its hit points to an enemy at 0.5 tile, an eighth at 0.75 tile, and nothing at 1 tile; at most three enemies are hit, and a server test asserts each value.
